extension.description: Automatically set watched episodes on MyEpisodes.com
Ställ in automatiskt att visade avsnitt sparas på MyEpisodes.com
extension.news: v4.0.0 - Uses the MyEpisodes JSON API instead of reading the website. - Upgrades on their own: an install that still holds a username and password trades them for an API key on the first start. You need do nothing. - A new install pastes a key from myepisodes.com, Account, API Keys. - Needs Kodi 20 or later. - Fixes new installs marking an episode watched after 2% of playback. - Fixes the "Mark as watched from" setting, which listed compass points.
